tags.title: EXPLAIN - partition pruning on event_date
tags.concept: EXPLAIN (TYPE DISTRIBUTED); Iceberg partition pruning; predicate pushdown
tags.question: Does a filter on the partition column limit which data files Trino scans?
tags.interpretation: Look for the event_date constraint pushed into the TableScan (connector-level constraint). Iceberg prunes whole partitions (and files by min/max stats) before any Parquet is read. (Literal filter: Trino does not bind prepared-statement parameters inside EXPLAIN (TYPE ...).)
